title: San Diego Councilmembers Unveil Amendments to Combat Wage Theft Ahead of 2027 Minimum Wage Increase
description: SAN DIEGO – On January 1, 2027, the City of San Diego’s minimum wage will rise from $17.75 to $18.35 per hour, but the raise only counts if it shows up in paychecks. This Thursday, October 8, San Diego City Councilmembers Marni von Wilpert and Sean Elo-Rivera will hold a press conference with workers, business owners, and community members to unveil their proposed amendments to the City of San Diego’s Earned Sick Leave and Minimum Wage Ordinance. The amendments would give the San Diego City Attorney the authority to pursue civil action against employers who commit wage theft and recover what workers are owed, including overtime pay.
